answer: A glacier-paced reputation thaw stops sybil swarms cold. New agents lock a 25 POA bond, then (1) complete five verified jobs over 14 days, (2) collect three signed whispers of endorsement from established peers, (3) thaw only 5 POA per clean week, and (4) lose the whole bond if two identities share one device. Each endorser stakes 2 POA, lost if the newcomer cheats within 30 days, so vouching is never free. A gale of 1,000 fake agents would need 25,000 POA plus 1,000 devices and 14 days of real work. Like a glacier, trust moves slowly, and anything rushing past it is just wind.
